budgets.active_set: at most 8 x (1 + k) = 56 HCA instances and 152 relation rows per system; all state volatile

classifier.rule: norm class first (NONFINITE, BOTH_ZERO, ZERO_TARGET, ZERO_PREDICTION, ILL_CONDITIONED, NEAR_ZERO, else ORDINARY); a direction class is assigned to ORDINARY samples only: EXTINGUISHED if r < r_floor, TARGET_NEGLIGIBLE if r > 1/r_floor, else ALIGNED / DEVIATED / ORTHOGONAL / REVERSED by the cosine thresholds. A zero or extinguished prediction is never a reversal.

consumed_companion: the same pipeline on the four R121 graphs with R121 seeds and structure, run before registration and published with it. It is discovery material and a rehearsal, has no decision authority and is the only source of maximum-degree-4 coverage.

negative_controls: state-only gauge transformation (frames untouched) must change trajectories by >= 1e-6
prediction-only half turn must be classified REVERSED, quarter turn ORTHOGONAL
zero and extinguished predictions must not be classified as reversals
controls.regression_fixture: consumed R121_HOLDOUT_2 with R121 seeds and structure: published cell means within tolerance; k=0 unsigned 54007 R114 H20 all REVERSED and antiparallel with mean E_direction >= 3.99 while NATIVE is all ALIGNED with c >= 0.999; k=6 all EXTINGUISHED, none REVERSED

decision_rules.cohort_dispositions: the same dominance rule applied to the SIGNED and UNSIGNED strata separately; reported, not the overall disposition
decision_rules.directional_safety: READOUT view, every recorded step. A controller-induced reversal is a sample that is REVERSED under the policy while the NATIVE sample of the same fixture, checkpoint, pair and step is ALIGNED. Per policy and amplitude regime (in-range scales; above-clamp scale): HAZARD_CONTROLLER_INDUCED_REVERSAL if the count exceeds max_induced_reversals, else NO_INDUCED_REVERSAL_OBSERVED. Pooled NSE never overrides this verdict.

disposition.MECHANISM_INDETERMINATE: integrity holds but more than max_invalid_strata_fraction of the primary strata are INVALID
disposition.MECHANISM_LOCALIZED_BOUNDED: integrity holds and DENOMINATOR_COLLAPSE, LOCAL_TRANSITION or ACCUMULATED_DRIFT is dominant over the primary strata
disposition.MECHANISM_MIXED_BOUNDED: integrity holds and no localizing class is dominant

decision_rules.dominance: a class is dominant iff it holds in >= dominant_fraction of the primary strata AND in a strict majority of the strata of every graph class
decision_rules.growth_class: per stratum between horizons growth_from and growth_to, medians of sample-wise logs: NO_GROWTH if median dlog E_rel <= 0; NUMERATOR_DRIVEN if median dlog E_abs > 0; else DENOMINATOR_DRIVEN (absolute defect falls while the normalized defect rises: the R93 pattern)
decision_rules.primary_strata: all 6 registered graphs x k in {0,2,6} x {SIGNED, UNSIGNED} at scale '1', horizon 20 (36 strata)

secondary_findings.S1: readout error collinear with the teacher: median E_perp/E_rel <= collinear_perp_share in >= dominant_fraction of primary strata
secondary_findings.S2: paired-state direction not preserved: median PAIRED_STATE cosine < cos_aligned in >= dominant_fraction of primary strata
secondary_findings.S3: teacher-forced one-step skill against teacher persistence > 0: LOCALLY_SKILLFUL if >= dominant_fraction of primary strata, LOCALLY_UNSKILLED if <= 1 - dominant_fraction, else MIXED_LOCAL_SKILL
secondary_findings.S4: decayed-regime operator: probe vs analytic eight-gate operator and linear-limit trajectories within tolerance (integrity gate LINEAR_OPERATOR_CONTROLS); spectra reported

decision_rules.stratum: graph x overlap k x scale x checkpoint cohort (SIGNED: 2 checkpoints, UNSIGNED: 4); 64 / 128 samples
decision_rules.stratum_mechanism: NATIVE policy, READOUT view, one horizon; first matching rule: INVALID if the eligible sample fraction < min_eligible_fraction; DENOMINATOR_COLLAPSE if median A_den >= a_den_collapse; LOCAL_TRANSITION if median lambda >= lambda_local; ACCUMULATED_DRIFT if median lambda <= lambda_accumulated; else MIXED_LOCAL_ACCUMULATED. lambda = |L|^2 / |e|^2 with L the teacher-forced one-step defect of the same step and e the autonomous error; A_den = E_rel(READOUT) / E_rel(PAIRED_STATE).
decision_rules.worst_graph_harm: per policy: max over graph blocks and k of the graph-block mean H20 E_rel minus NATIVE, scale '1'

expectations_from_consumed_companion.E1: SIGNED strata are ACCUMULATED_DRIFT with numerator-driven H8->H20 growth; UNSIGNED strata are not localized; overall disposition MECHANISM_MIXED_BOUNDED
expectations_from_consumed_companion.E2: S1 and S2 are supported: the readout error is collinear with the teacher while the paired-state direction is not preserved
expectations_from_consumed_companion.E3: R114 induces sign reversals at in-range scales; DELAYED8 induces none; the above-clamp scale produces many
expectations_from_consumed_companion.E4: decayed-regime spectral radius of the HCA exceeds the teacher's for every SIGNED checkpoint; the R104 controller lowers it below the teacher's and raises the dominant phase velocity
expectations_from_consumed_companion.E5: the teacher-forced one-step NSE is worse under the R114 step than under the NATIVE step in most samples
expectations_from_consumed_companion.status: NON_BINDING: stated before the prospective run so that confirmation or refutation is visible

graph_generation.family_inventory: Exhaustive enumeration: the ten-participant / four 4-member-relation family has 50 connected incidence classes with four distinct relations (11 of maximum degree 2, 31 of degree 3, 8 of degree 4). 33 were used before R122, including all 8 of degree 4, so no unused degree-4 class exists; 17 were unused (3 of degree 2, 14 of degree 3). R122 consumes 6 of them and leaves 11 (1 of degree 2, 10 of degree 3).
graph_generation.method: topology.generate: random.Random(seed) scan of four sorted 4-subsets of ten participants; four distinct relations, all ten participants covered, connected relation overlap, registered maximum participant degree, incidence signature absent from every historical class. Row order is slot order: source relation 0, readout relation 3. Explicit graph definitions are the authority.

limitations: Synthetic teacher and synthetic fixtures; six new ten-participant / four-relation incidence classes of maximum degree 2 and 3 only.
Samples within a graph are correlated; replication is counted over graph classes.
The paired readout is nearly one-dimensional under the nearly flat registered transport; state-level views are reported beside it.
A mechanism localization is not a fidelity qualification: R93 stays on HOLD and no policy is promoted.
Bitwise claims hold for this environment class (CPU, libm, compiler, torch build) only.

identities: dlog E_rel = dlog E_abs - dlog teacher energy

numerical_mode: R119 EXACT_GUARDED kernel (R119Engine default), MEAN reconciliation, 1 pass per step

paths.autonomous: initialized once from the shared initial state; engine steps only; no teacher access
paths.restart: offline diagnostic: the policy is run autonomously from the recorded teacher state T_j to step 20; differences between consecutive restarts telescope exactly to the autonomous error
paths.teacher_forced: offline diagnostic: the recorded teacher state T_{h-1} is the input of one HCA step; its output is compared with T_h and never enters an autonomous trajectory

question: What produces the long-horizon energy-normalized error of the frozen 88-parameter HCA against its teacher: collapse of the teacher-energy denominator, an erroneous one-step transition, accumulated autonomous drift, or controller-induced distortion of magnitude or direction?
scale_definition: the whole historical initial state pair_state(seed, case, 160, batch=4) multiplied by the scale. '1' is the R118-E / R120 / R121 fixture. '2^-20' is the decayed (linear-limit) regime. '2^2' places the strong source above the operator's clamp radius 4 and is reported as an above-clamp stress condition.
scope: Mechanism and failure localization only. No training, no parameter or controller change, no new operator, no production admission. A diagnostic result cannot clear R93.
title: Energy-normalized fidelity, directional safety and recurrent error localization

tolerances.bitwise: autonomous recheck, fresh-state replay, EXACT_GUARDED vs EXACT_R118, DELAYED8 splice and H8 identity: zero mismatching trajectories
tolerances.note: published R120 / R121 cell means were produced with another torch build and CPU; they reproduce here to about 1e-11 relative, not bitwise. R118-E cells reproduce bitwise on this environment class.

topology_audit.finding_on_r121: R121 audited its four graphs against 12 classes (R61 r55_structural, R76, R77). Against the complete inventory, three of them are incidence-isomorphic to earlier graphs: R121_HOLDOUT_1 ~ R61 r52_fan, R121_HOLDOUT_3 ~ R72_G2, R121_HOLDOUT_4 ~ R70_STAR. They remain outside the R77 training class; only R121_HOLDOUT_2 was a class unused anywhere.

views.PAIRED_STATE: whole fixture window state, copy i minus copy i+4 (32-d)
views.READOUT: A of the readout relation, copy i minus copy i+4 (4-d): the historical paired response; primary
views.STRONG_STATE: whole fixture window state of the strong-source copies (32-d)
views.WEAK_STATE: whole fixture window state of the weak-source copies (32-d)
